summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. filed an 8-K reporting continued progress in the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission's formal review of its Construction Permit Application for the KRONOS MMR Energy System at the University of Illinois. The press release notes a June 23 meeting marking the start of review activities, following acceptance on May 18, 2026, with environmental assessment expected in Spring 2027 and safety evaluation in early Fall 2027. No deal terms, financial transactions, or special-situation catalysts are present; this is a routine operational update on regulatory milestones.
